title: Scotch, Bourbon or Irish?

cards.clue: By law, it must be at least 51% corn.
cards.explain: Bourbon. At least 51% corn, aged in new charred oak, made in the USA.

cards.clue: It must age at least 3 years in oak, in one country only.
cards.explain: Scotch. Minimum three years in oak casks, in Scotland.

cards.clue: It’s famous for being distilled three times.
cards.explain: Irish whiskey. Triple distillation is its classic style: lighter and smoother.

outro.cta: Send this to the friend who calls every whisky ‘Scotch’.
outro.pill: DRINK SLOW · NEVER DRINK AND DRIVE

caption:
Scotch, Bourbon or Irish? 🥃 3 clues, 3 seconds each. How many did you get right?

Comment your score out of 3 👇 and send this to the friend who calls every whisky “Scotch”.

Answers: Bourbon must be at least 51% corn. Scotch must age at least 3 years in oak, in Scotland. Irish whiskey is famous for triple distillation.

Drink slow. Never drink and drive. 18+
